Never a kept file, anyone's: a claimed or stored id is left as it is, and so is an id with no file. ### stripImageMetadata()

```ts
function stripImageMetadata(input, type): Uint8Array;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/files.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/files.ts)

An image's bytes without its EXIF, XMP, IPTC and GPS data, its container
rewritten and its pixels untouched, so quality is unchanged: JPEG, PNG and
WebP. A photo taken sideways keeps its orientation, alone, so it still
shows upright. Any other type comes back as it is. Throws on a file whose
container is broken, which a check reads as a type it does not accept.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `input` | `ArrayBuffer` \| `Uint8Array`\<`ArrayBufferLike`\> |
| `type` | `string` |

#### Returns

`Uint8Array`

### setupStorage()

```ts
function setupStorage<DM>(components, options?): Storage<DM>;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/storage.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/storage.ts)

Checked uploads, expiring private URLs and share links on Convex file
storage, kept in the `backend` component's storage beside one owner
record per file: the orphan sweep, an account's export and its erasure
see every file the app keeps.

A photo goes to your mutation as bytes, and `store` checks them (size,
the type read from the bytes, the quotas), strips an image's EXIF, XMP
and GPS data, and keeps it with your row in one transaction. A large file
goes to an upload URL (`generateUploadUrl`, behind `useUpload` and
`<UploadField>`), and your mutation `claim`s it: the size and the quotas
at once, the type and the stripping next.

#### Type Parameters

| Type Parameter | Default type |
| ------ | ------ |
| <a id="type-parameter-dm-3"></a> `DM` *extends* `GenericDataModel` | `GenericDataModel` |

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `components` | [`StorageComponents`](#storagecomponents) |
| `options?` | [`SetupStorageOptions`](#setupstorageoptions) |

#### Returns

[`Storage`](#storage)\<`DM`\>

#### Example

```ts [backend/storage.ts]
import { setupStorage } from 'nuxt-backend/storage'
import { components } from './_generated/api'
import type { DataModel } from './_generated/dataModel'

export const storage = setupStorage<DataModel>(components, {
  maxSize: 8 * 1024 * 1024,
  accept: ['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'],
  quota: { files: 200, bytes: 500 * 1024 * 1024 },
})

export const { generateUploadUrl, getFileUrl } = storage.api
```
